record.name: Devin
record.one_liner: Devin is an autonomous AI software engineer that can write, run, and test code, available via web app, CLI, and a public REST API.

auth.notes: Both scopes use service user credentials with a cog_ prefix, sent via Bearer token in the Authorization header. Personal Access Tokens are also supported.

access.notes: Users can sign up directly at app.devin.ai or use self-serve free and paid plans.

api_surface.notes: The Devin API is organized into Organization and Enterprise scopes with base URLs like https://api.devin.ai/v3/organizations/*.

mcp.notes: The fetched documentation does not mention the Model Context Protocol.

buildability.reasoning: Self-serve signup is available and the API is fully documented with service user credentials and standard HTTP endpoints.

evidence.claim: To access Devin, sign up at app.devin.ai.
The API uses service user credentials and is organized into Organization and Enterprise scopes under https://api.devin.ai/v3/.
Free and paid self-serve plans are available on the pricing page.
